acceptanceCriteria: Define a bounded manifest of participating repositories, primary repository, immutable bases/candidates, independent reviews, gates and integrated commits.
Qualify one existing multi-repository Beamfall ticket through native completion using actual integration and gate policy.
Missing repository, stale candidate, partial integration, unavailable commit, changed policy or failed gate prevents completion; retries do not duplicate completion.
Preserve existing single-repository wire compatibility and fail closed on unsupported multi-repository inputs.
body:
Required by Beamfall tickets with a Primary Repo and participating repositories. Current native completion observes one Git root and intentBranch. Specify queue authority and bind every required repository without accepting partial merges as ticket completion.
